items.title: Tommy Ridgley Interview, 1986-03-22
items.q: The interviewee is Thomas Ridgely (spelled Ridgely). The person to judge is 'Thomas Ridgely'. The transcript confirms the interviewee's name is Thomas Ridgely. There is no mention of a separate individual named Thomas Ridgely with whom the interviewee has a relationship.

ctx.x: Okay, we got that out of the way. One thing I wanted to, when you were growing up, what did people call you? Tommy, Thomas?
Thomas. Thomas. Everybody know me as Thomas.
Grandmother, parents? Thomas, all of them call me Thomas. I didn't have a nickname. Your brothers call you Thomas? Yeah, they all call me Thomas.
